```swift
// Features/Camera/CameraCapabilityDetecting.swift
import Foundation

protocol CameraCapabilityDetecting {
    func currentStatus() -> CameraCapabilityStatus
}

enum CameraCapabilityStatus: Sendable {
    case ready
    case noHardware
    case denied
    case restricted
}
```

```swift
// Features/Camera/CameraStatusChecker.swift
import AVFoundation
import UIKit

final class CameraStatusChecker: CameraCapabilityDetecting {
    
    func currentStatus() -> CameraCapabilityStatus {
        guard UIImagePickerController.isSourceTypeAvailable(.camera) else {
            return .noHardware
        }
        
        let status = AVCaptureDevice.authorizationStatus(for: .video)
        
        switch status {
        case .authorized:
            return .ready
        case .denied:
            return .denied
        case .restricted:
            return .restricted
        default:
            return .ready // Assume ready if not explicitly denied or restricted
        }
    }
}
```

```swift
// Features/Vision/VisionPoseProcessor.swift
import AVFoundation
import Vision
import CoreMedia
import Observation

final class VisionPoseProcessor: NSObject, AVCaptureVideoDataOutputSampleBufferDelegate {
    var onJointFrame: (@Sendable (JointFrame) -> Void)?

    func captureOutput(_ output: AVCaptureOutput, didOutput sampleBuffer: CMSampleBuffer, from connection: AVCaptureConnection) {
        guard let pixelBuffer = CMSampleBufferGetImageBuffer(sampleBuffer),
              let ciImage = CIImage(cvPixelBuffer: pixelBuffer, options: nil) else { return }
        
        let timestamp = CMSampleBufferGetPresentationTimeStamp(sampleBuffer).seconds
        processJointFrame(ciImage: ciImage, timestamp: timestamp)
    }
    
    private func processJointFrame(ciImage: CIImage, timestamp: TimeInterval) {
        let handler = VNImageRequestHandler(ciImage: ciImage, options: [:])
        let request = VNDetectHumanPoseRequest { [weak self] request, error in
            guard let results = request.results as? [VNRecognizedHumanPoseObservation],
                  let result = results.first else { return }
            
            if let jointFrame = PoseObservationAdapter.makeJointFrame(from: result, timestamp: timestamp) {
                DispatchQueue.main.async {
                    self?.onJointFrame?(jointFrame)
                }
            }
        }
        
        try? handler.perform([request])
    }
}
```
